prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1318; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents our client in connection with the rear-end collision in which they were injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact, please refer those inquiries to us.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured for the incident, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information within thirty days of receipt of this letter.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any communications with your insured or third parties. Failure to preserve this material may result in sanctions in any later proceeding.

We look forward to your prompt response.
